THE NAME BEHIND THE WORK

Plumbing at the heart.
More for your home.

You may know the business as Grandison Gas. Today, Grandison Plumbing & Heating reflects the wider range of work: bathrooms, boiler installations, heating systems and everyday plumbing.

Connor Grandison operates the business from Fife. Whether you’re planning a complete bathroom renovation or need help with plumbing or heating, that is the name behind Grandison.

A bathroom is more than its finished fittings. The water supply, waste pipes and heating all matter too. Our work brings those practical elements together with the spaces you see and use.

GOOD TO KNOW

A few straightforward answers.

Who runs Grandison Plumbing & Heating?

The business is operated by Connor Grandison and is based in Fife, Scotland.

Is this the business previously called Grandison Gas?

Yes. Grandison Plumbing & Heating was previously known as Grandison Gas. The current name reflects the wider bathroom, plumbing and heating work the business provides.

Where does Grandison work?

Fife is the main service area. For work in Edinburgh or elsewhere, confirm availability and coverage with Connor before arranging a visit.

Where can I read customer feedback?

Connor has an existing customer review profile on MyBuilder, where you can read feedback on previous work.
